meta.name: The Remix 720p
meta.description: On this music competition show, some of the coolest musicians rejig, reshuffle and remix popular Bollywood songs. A singer and DJ team up to create a fresh spin culminating in a musical extravaganza.

videos.title: Best Foot Forward
videos.overview: Power packed performances by all the 3 judges – Sunidhi, Amit & Nucleya kick off the series. The ten teams put their best foot forward in this showcase episode. With some head-banging numbers & outstanding performances, this non-elimination episode offers a sensational line up of tracks that are sure to go into your playlist!

videos.title: Movie Title Track
videos.overview: Remixing Title Tracks of favourite Bollywood Movies is the theme for this episode. Faced with the first elimination, the ten teams are at their sharpest best. With their own versions of tracks like Desi Boyzz, Rock On! and Ashiqui amongst others, watch our talented duos turn on the heat to stay in the game….

videos.title: Featuring Live Instruments
videos.overview: To spice things up, we have added live instrumentation in this episode. Each team is given an interesting instrument to incorporate into their track. With the Sarangi making its way into Darkhwast, The Harmonium into Baby Doll, Bagpipe into Uff Teri Ada, its time to witness some mind blowing performances. To add to the excitement, the 3 judges 'Swing' and jam up with some amazing Live Musicians!

videos.title: Love
videos.overview: In this episode of The Remix, the theme of Love brings with it a line-up of 8 romantic and heart-warming tracks that include Raabta, Gazab ka hai din and Sunn raha hai na tu. With some outstanding performances, this episode takes the competition to a new high resulting in a shocking elimination. A must watch for all those who are in love and also for those who want to be in love!

videos.title: Found Sound
videos.overview: Experimentation with sound now takes a new leap! Tricky but wonderful, this episode's theme is about including Ambient Sounds into popular Bollywood songs. Our inspired contestants deliver some of the best tracks of the season using regular, routine sounds from the kitchen, market place, garage etc. Watch the judges groove to these foot stomping tracks. #OnLoop

videos.title: Guest Performers
videos.overview: 6 phenomenal guest singers - Rajakumari, Nikhita Gandhi, Nakash Aziz, Shadab Faridi, Mame Khan & Ikka join the party in this episode and transform it into a grand affair! This episode comes with a No Elimination tag and the competition hits a pause, making way for some brilliant collaborations, superb performances and remixed tracks that are simply hard to forget.

videos.title: Retro Remixes
videos.overview: 'Bass Ka Raja' Nucleya starts off this party with his signature style performance. Remixing new tracks in Retro style brings a fresh new take to songs like Matargashti, Ambarsariya and Chittiyan Kalaiyan complemented with some of the craziest and most mesmerising performances. Watch NOW to find out which teams make it to the TOP 5 on the Remix!

videos.title: Judge's Challenge and Medley
videos.overview: Sunidhi's rocking performance opens the show with a bang, but the fight is on for the TOP 4! In this episode the 5 teams present their versions of the tracks specially selected by the judges for them. But that's not it, there is a 2nd round too. The teams perform a MEDLEY of yesteryear's tracks which takes the show to a new high of path-breaking Music!

videos.title: Sound of Nation and Global Beats
videos.overview: Two rounds of competition raise the bar for the 4 teams in this semi-final episode. Round 1 tests their ability to use International influences on Bollywood tracks. Round 2 challenges them to incorporate sounds from different regions of India. With the teams, weaving their magic on tracks like Genda Phool, Fevicol Se and Kabhi Kabhi Aditi, which 3 teams will make it to the Grand Finale?
